summary: Pole platform 1927; wooden L-6 tower completed around 1938; renamed Billings Point in 1948; removed or destroyed in 1962. No source describes the site now.

facts.design: Pole platform (1927), then an 84- to 86-foot wooden L-6 tower with an L-4 type ground cabin (late 1930s)
facts.status_note: Tower removed or destroyed in 1962 (sources differ on the word). No source describes what remains at the site now.

events.note: 84-foot wooden L-6 tower with ground cabin, per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; the 1942 association report says 1938
Constructed in 1938 per the 1942 Clearwater TPA annual report; a January 1939 item says the 86-foot tower was completed that summer
Formerly Summit Lookout, renamed C.L. Billings point after a past association president
Virtually destroyed in the fall, during hunting season, per the association report
Restored, per the combined 1955-56 association report
After the 1962 fire season the tower, in poor condition, was removed; better detection made it no longer cost effective (association report)
Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both say destroyed in 1962

corrections.proposed: 84- to 86-foot wooden L-6 tower with an L-4 type ground cabin
corrections.why: L-4 is the cabin type in the 1939 newspaper item; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give the tower type as L-6.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1937; the 1942 association report says 1938; a January 1939 item says the new tower was completed that summer.
The 1939 item says 86 feet; the 1942 report and firelookout.com say 84 feet. The record keeps 26.2 m (86 ft).
The association's 1962 report says the tower was removed after the fire season in poor condition; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed in 1962.

sources.title: Billings - Forest Lookouts
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (Idaho); quotes Clearwater TPA annual reports and a 1939 Lewiston Morning Tribune item

notes_for_editor: Record design 'L-4' is the cabin type; the tower is L-6 per firelookout.com and the 1939 item's cabin note, proposed as a correction. Height 26.2 m (86 ft) is kept from the 1939 item; the 1942 report and later pages say 84 ft. Build year (1937 vs 1938) and 1962 fate (removed vs destroyed) are reported as conflicts. No source describes the site now, or whether it is open to visitors. Lead, not used: a 1950 photo titled Billings Point lookout tower in the Potlatch Lumber Company collection at the University of Idaho (https://www.lib.uidaho.edu/digital/plcphotos/items/plcphotos721.html). Its license was not checked, so it is not in photos. Its coordinates (46.636, -115.804) are about 4 km from the record's point. Budget: 2 searches and 4 page reads used.
